\node[card] (a) {\heading{1}{Lipschitz乗数で元のBochner式を使う}{Use original Bochner with a Lipschitz multiplier}

$B_V(g,\xi)\ge\int k\xi\Gamma(g)\,dm_V$};
\flow{a}{b}{\Tx{容量を考慮したBochner測度と積の法則。弱Hessian上界を適用する。}{Use the capacity-aware Bochner measure and product rule; apply the weak upper bound.}\\[3pt]\Cite{sav-measure}\quad\Cite{bochner}};
